HSGQ-XE08R 8-Port EPON OLT – High-Density FTTH/FTTB Fiber Access Solution


The HSGQ-XE08R EPON OLT is a high-performance 8-Port Optical Line Terminal designed for modern FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB (Fiber to the Building), and FTTx network deployments. With advanced EPON technology, powerful 10G uplinks, and intelligent management features, it delivers exceptional stability, scalability, and speed for ISPs, data centers, and enterprise networks.


Key Features:


  • 8 EPON Ports – Supports up to 512 ONUs (1:64 split per port) for large-scale FTTH access.
  • High-Speed Uplink Options – Equipped with 4× Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 and 4× 10G SFP+ uplink ports for seamless backbone connectivity.
  • Robust Performance – Powered by 512MB DDR memory and 32MB Flash, ensuring stable, high-speed data transmission.
  • Flexible Power Supply – Supports AC 100–240V with optional dual AC/DC redundant power for reliable operation.
  • Advanced Layer 2 Features – VLAN, QinQ, QoS, ACL, link aggregation, port isolation, and loop detection for network efficiency.
  • Smart Management – Manage easily via Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, or centralized NMS for complete control and monitoring.
  • Compact & Durable Design – 1U rackmount metal chassis (442×260×44mm) built for 24/7 data center environments.
  • Wide Temperature Range – Operates reliably from –10°C to 60°C in diverse installation conditions.


Why Choose HSGQ-XE08R EPON OLT:


  • Ideal for Internet Service Providers (ISPs) expanding FTTH networks.
  • Compatible with multiple EPON ONUs for flexible deployment.
  • Supports triple-play services (Internet, IPTV, and VoIP).
  • Energy-efficient and cost-effective, reducing operational costs.
  • Perfect for medium to large-scale fiber network infrastructures.


Technical Specifications:

  • Model: HSGQ-XE08R
  • PON Ports: 8 × EPON SFP slots
  • Uplink Ports: 4 × GE RJ45 + 4 × 10G SFP+
  • Max ONUs Supported 512 (1:64 per port)
  • Memory / Flash 512MB DDR / 32MB Flash
  • Power Supply: AC 100–240V (optional DC/dual)
  • Operating Temperature –10°C to +60°C
  • Size (W×D×H) 442 × 260 × 44 mm (1U)
  • Management: Web, CLI, SNMP, NMS, Cloud
